name: NCAA D-I West Regional Cross Country Championships
where: Sacramento, CA · Arcade Creek Cross Country Course
headline: NCAA D-I West Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: No. 11 Oregon won the women’s race with 38 points over No. 17 Washington State (109), led by winner Diana Cherotich in 18:55.6. No. 5 Oregon’s men won with 51 points ahead of Washington (110) and No. 19 Stanford (115). Washington State’s Solomon Kipchoge won the men’s race in 28:37.6, 12 seconds ahead of teammate Evans Kurui.
